name: TrafegoDNS
description: TrafegoDNS automatically manages DNS records based on container configuration. It supports both Traefik integration and direct Docker container label mode, making it compatible with any web server or reverse proxy solution. Key Features: - Supports multiple DNS providers (Cloudflare, DigitalOcean, Route53) - Two operation modes: Traefik API integration or direct Docker labels - Optional cleanup of orphaned DNS records - Real-time monitoring of Docker container events - Please refer to the readme before deploying this container: https://github.com/elmerfds/TrafegoDNS

variables.name: Operation Mode
variables.description: Choose how to detect hostnames: Traefik API or direct container labels

variables.name: DNS Provider
variables.description: Select DNS provider to use

variables.name: Cloudflare Token
variables.description: Cloudflare API token (requires DNS edit permissions) - Required when using Cloudflare provider

variables.name: Cloudflare Zone
variables.description: Your domain name managed in Cloudflare (e.g., example.com) - Required when using Cloudflare provider

variables.name: DigitalOcean Token
variables.description: DigitalOcean API token (requires write access) - Required when using DigitalOcean provider

variables.name: DigitalOcean Domain
variables.description: Your domain name managed in DigitalOcean (e.g., example.com) - Required when using DigitalOcean provider

variables.name: Route53 Access Key
variables.description: AWS IAM access key with Route53 permissions - Required when using Route53 provider

variables.name: Route53 Secret Key
variables.description: AWS IAM secret key - Required when using Route53 provider

variables.name: Route53 Zone
variables.description: Your domain name managed in Route53 (e.g., example.com) - Required when using Route53 provider

variables.name: Traefik API URL
variables.description: URL to Traefik API (including protocol and port) - Only used when Operation Mode is 'traefik'

variables.name: Cleanup Orphaned
variables.description: Whether to automatically remove orphaned DNS records

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User ID to run as

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group ID to run as

variables.name: Log Level
variables.description: Logging level

variables.name: Preserved Hostnames
variables.description: Comma-separated list of hostnames to preserve from cleanup (supports wildcards)

variables.name: Managed Hostnames
variables.description: Comma-separated list of hostnames to create and maintain (format: hostname:type:content:ttl:proxied)

variables.name: Traefik API Username
variables.description: Optional basic auth username for Traefik API - Only used when Operation Mode is 'traefik'

variables.name: Traefik API Password
variables.description: Optional basic auth password for Traefik API - Only used when Operation Mode is 'traefik'

variables.name: Route53 Zone ID
variables.description: Alternative to ROUTE53_ZONE: Your Route53 hosted zone ID - Only used when DNS Provider is 'route53'

variables.name: Route53 Region
variables.description: AWS region for Route53 API calls - Only used when DNS Provider is 'route53'
